manifest.truth_sampling: Independent uniform unit coordinates in [0.1,0.9]; central domain only, not full-boundary coverage
manifest.scope: Frozen-model synthetic assessment; one training initialization does not establish seed-wise reliability or market-data recovery
manifest.noise: independent Gaussian standard deviation 1% of true option time value above intrinsic; no truncation/resampling
manifest.selection: minimum ANN IV calibration SSE across fixed seeded LHS starts
manifest.fit_information: calibration strikes and observed IV only; no truth, holdout, exact-pricer trial evaluations

geometry.holdout: zero-based strike index % 3 == 2 at every expiry

manifest.parameter_gate: all positive-parameter relative errors <= 5%; all rho absolute errors <= .05
manifest.price_gate: RMSE over heldout quotes <= 1e-5 of spot; original exact synthetic prices are the scoring target
manifest.invalid_policy: Any noninvertible generated or noisy observation invalidates the entire case; counts remain in denominators
manifest.quadrature_gate: true and fitted 96-vs-128 node prices differ by <= 1e-8 of spot

optimizer.algorithm: bounded SciPy TRF with analytic PyTorch Jacobian; identical MLX-trained weights evaluated in float64

config.selection: original four development recovery surfaces; never exposed-12 truth in optimizer
config.calibration: optimize frozen neural IV predictions only; no exact pricing in fit
config.optimizer: L-BFGS-B on network weights, fixed objective; unbounded neural weights
config.precision: float32 MLX values/gradients, float64 SciPy optimizer vectors
